body: Just wanted to mention that I actually prefer keeping the UI logic in code when it isn't too complex :-) but it's not a big deal either way.

There's one issue: the PiP params can also be updated by the game. When the game runs, it updates the PiP aspect ratio after I set it in `loadWindowBounds()`. Because of that, the first PiP toggle always uses the default aspect ratio, but subsequent launches work correctly.

Pushed a fix for this
Updating params just before entering PiP.
Either coerce the aspect ratio to the closest bound or skip updating `pipAspectRatio` but you should let the rest of the function continue instead of returning early.
From testing the update, let's go ahead with coercing the given aspect ration to the closest bounds if it's outside of the range.
